## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

1. Global Risk Regime?  
ROTATION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: +0.13% | 1M: -8.18%) RECOVERY showing moderating fear and HYG (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +0.24%) ABOVE TREND with LQD (1W: +0.85% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND showing stable credit; Consumer Cycle (1W: +2.16% | 1M: -5.25%) RECOVERY and Industrial Strength (1W: +1.56% | 1M: +7.76%) ABOVE TREND confirm cyclical rotation.

2. Primary Risk Drivers?  
Credit stability: HYG (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +0.24%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.85% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND → credit stress easing (↑ rising). Fear/moderation: VXX (1W: +0.13% | 1M: -8.18%) RECOVERY → fear decreasing. Rates/bonds: TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +2.40%) ABOVE TREND → duration preference rising (↑ rising).

3. Financial Conditions Signal?  
Dollar neutral/correcting: dollar index (1W: -0.28% | 1M: +2.57%) CORRECTION. Yield picture supportive of bonds: TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +2.40%) ABOVE TREND and SPY (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -1.55%) BELOW TREND keeps stocks vs bonds flat/neutral.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

4. Sector Leadership?  
Healthcare/Biotech leading: XBI (1W: +8.54% | 1M: +16.53%) ABOVE TREND and XLV (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials showing strength: XLI (1W: +0.53% | 1M: +5.41%) ABOVE TREND. Tech lagging: XLK (1W: -3.51% | 1M: -0.65%) BELOW TREND — style: rotation away from Tech toward Healthcare/Cyclicals.

5. US vs Global?  
US small-caps outpacing: IWM (1W: +0.26% | 1M: +2.62%) ABOVE TREND while SPY (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -1.55%) BELOW TREND. EM/China weak: EEM (1W: -5.31% | 1M: -1.21%) BELOW TREND and FXI (1W: -5.15% | 1M: -8.69%) BELOW TREND; Europe mixed/CORRECTION: VGK (1W: -0.20% | 1M: +0.27%) CORRECTION.

6. Speculative Appetite?  
Mixed: Speculation index rising but IBIT (1W: -6.36% | 1M: -17.76%) BELOW TREND shows crypto weakness while ARKK (1W: +2.81% | 1M: -0.47%) RECOVERY and XBI ABOVE TREND show pockets of speculative strength.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

7. Commodities Theme?  
Commodities broadly weak: GLD (1W: -4.16% | 1M: -10.71%) BELOW TREND and CPER (1W: -4.07% | 1M: -4.69%) BELOW TREND — reflation signals mixed despite earlier CPER_GLD reading.

8. Energy Trend?  
Energy under pressure: XLE (1W: -0.89% | 1M: -5.24%) BELOW TREND and BNO (1W: -5.26% | 1M: -20.42%) BELOW TREND; natural gas soft: UNG (1W: -2.89% | 1M: -3.87%) BELOW TREND.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?  
Confirmed: Healthcare/Small-cap leadership (XBI, XLV, IJR all ABOVE TREND). Divergences: SOXX (1W: -6.21% | 1M: +7.93%) CORRECTION, MTUM (1W: -2.67% | 1M: +6.90%) CORRECTION and XLK BELOW TREND create MAJOR divergence signals—suppress blanket risk-on conviction.

10. Portfolio Direction?  
Favor sectors showing strength: XBI (1W: +8.54% | 1M: +16.53%) ABOVE TREND, XLV (1W: +7.12% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND and XLF (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +5.15%) ABOVE TREND; reduce exposure to XLK (1W: -3.51% | 1M: -0.65%) BELOW TREND and commodity-sensitive ETFs like SLV (1W: -10.58% | 1M: -22.94%) BELOW TREND while monitoring bond positioning via TLT (1W: +1.58% | 1M: +2.40%) ABOVE TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Sectors to Watch?  
BULLISH: Healthcare/biotech — XBI (1W: +8.54% | 1M: +16.53%) ABOVE TREND if earnings/flows continue.  
BEARISH: Technology — XLK (1W: -3.51% | 1M: -0.65%) BELOW TREND if momentum erosion persists.

12. Commodities to Watch?  
BULLISH: None obvious near-term; monitor copper for reversal.  
BEARISH: Gold/precious metals — GLD (1W: -4.16% | 1M: -10.71%) BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -10.58% | 1M: -22.94%) BELOW TREND remain under pressure.

13. Key Levels?  
VXX ~20 (complacency threshold); HYG/LQD parity ~0.8 (credit health); XLK/XLF pivot (~watch spread) for growth vs value leadership.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

ROTATION. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive and cycle indicators (Industrial Strength, Consumer Cycle) show recovery while risk is mixed. Healthcare/biotech and small-caps are showing strength, tech and commodities are showing weakness — major divergences in SOXX/MTUM/XLK are the key risk to monitor.
